new_categories.label: dry_cargo_damage_condition_assurance_readiness
new_categories.memory: A bounded dry-cargo damage-condition survey/observation assurance state can be represented separately from quantity, identity, contamination and downstream claims outcomes.

new_categories.label: damage_survey_observation_path_availability
new_categories.memory: Availability of a survey or observation path can be represented separately from the damage-condition judgment it supports.

new_categories.label: cargo_lot_hold_damage_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Damage-condition assurance can be bounded to a cargo lot, parcel, hold, stowage zone or operation stage without retaining exact cargo or location details.

new_categories.label: non_specific_damage_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-specific cargo-damage condition confidence state can be retained without naming damage type, severity, amount, cause or affected location.

new_categories.label: damage_observation_coverage_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that the intended cargo/hold scope has been observed can be represented separately from survey-path availability and condition judgment.

new_categories.label: damage_observation_representativeness_confidence
new_categories.memory: Observation representativeness is distinct from simple coverage and from the final damage-condition conclusion without retaining exact survey plans or sampling locations.

new_categories.label: damage_condition_verification_validity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence in the validity of a damage-condition assessment can degrade independently from observation-path availability without retaining exact findings or methods.

new_categories.label: damage_documentation_reference_availability
new_categories.memory: Availability of a bounded documentation/reference layer can be represented without retaining exact photos, reports, document identifiers or entries.

new_categories.label: damage_condition_documentation_alignment_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that documentation or references align to the intended cargo/lot/hold condition can be represented separately from identity traceability and from the underlying damage state.

new_categories.label: independent_damage_condition_crosscheck_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent or alternate survey/verification confidence can be represented separately from the primary observation path and without retaining claims procedure.

new_categories.label: damage_assurance_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Damage-condition assurance can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-verification and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_damage_restriction_downstream_not_root_cause
new_categories.memory: Restrictions can attach to survey path, scope, condition confidence, representativeness, documentation alignment or verification, while receiver concern, claims, rework or delay do not prove the root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_damage_assurance_restoration
new_categories.memory: Observation recovery, scope confirmation, condition re-verification, documentation alignment, independent cross-check, receiver confidence and restriction release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: damage_condition_vs_contamination_condition
useful_refinements.memory: Damage-condition assurance is broader/different from contamination, residue or foreign-material assurance; one condition can be satisfactory while another is degraded.

useful_refinements.label: damage_condition_vs_quantity_discrepancy
useful_refinements.memory: P124 quantity/mass assurance concerns how much cargo is represented, while damage-condition assurance concerns condition; shortage or quantity variance does not by itself establish damage.

useful_refinements.label: damage_documentation_vs_identity_traceability
useful_refinements.memory: P125 identity/lot traceability can remain intact while condition documentation is incomplete or misaligned, and damage documentation alignment does not itself establish identity integrity.

useful_refinements.label: survey_assurance_vs_claims_evidence_workflow
useful_refinements.memory: A bounded survey/observation and documentation-assurance state can be retained without retaining evidence-preservation, legal, claims, acceptance or response procedures.

duplicates.label: generic_observation_scope_representativeness_validity_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic observation-path availability, bounded scope, representativeness, validity and cross-check mechanics repeat prior measurement/condition families.

duplicates.label: generic_reference_alignment_restriction_restoration_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic reference alignment, restriction/isolation, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage restoration are already campaign-wide.

stop_reason: The bounded dry-cargo damage-condition survey/observation/documentation assurance questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact damage, survey findings, photos, reports, claims, acceptance rules, procedures, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo damage-condition survey/observation/documentation orientation/source-discovery output; not survey, evidence-preservation, claims, acceptance, cargo-response or legal/commercial guidance and not proof of any exact damage, finding, photo, document, value, rule, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
